frontier.hypothesis: Raise the POINTER pseudo's ref-weight above the counter without touching its (uncontrollable) live range, to flip the s0/s1 allocation.
frontier.mechanism: priority ~ n_refs*freq/live_length; pointer's long hoisted live range divides down its 2 loop refs. Add a loop-body pointer ref the counter can't mirror, or reduce the counter's loop weight.
frontier.next_probe: Try loop restructurings (extra live pointer use / counter-weight reduction); edit -> re-dump greg, watch for allocation order flipping to '74 75'.
